name: @rindle/wiki-demo
description: The tiny machine: a real rindled follower keeps three nested boards (most-active pages, just-edited pages, most-active editors) over Wikimedia's live recentchange firehose permanently pinned (warm with zero viewers) and fans the live results out to many browsers, which SHARE one materialization each. A thin Node tier (API server + ordered ingester) fronts the HCTree master/follower pair and resumes the stream from its offset on restart.

scripts.build:daemon: cargo build --manifest-path ../../rust/Cargo.toml -p rindle-server --bin rindled -p rindle-replicator --bin rindle-replicator
